title: Practice Service Features Schedule — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment: service features by practice type.**

| Practice type | Clinic hours per week outside 8am to 5pm weekdays | Behavioral health integrated on site | Days between required care-team contacts | Second opinion at no cost | PCP printed on member ID card |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 0 | No | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 0 | No | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 0 | No | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 4 | Yes | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 8 | Yes | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 0 | No | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 8 | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. *Extended hours* are clinic hours per week offered outside 8am to 5pm on weekdays; 0 means the practice type has no such requirement.
2. *Care-team contacts*: the figure is the number of calendar days between required care-team contacts with the member; 0 means no contact cadence applies.
3. *Second opinion*: under every practice type the member may obtain a second opinion from another in-network provider at no cost.
4. *ID card*: under every practice type the assigned PCP is printed on the member ID card, so a change triggers a new card. When an assignment made by the member's own selection or by plan reassignment takes effect, a replacement ID card is issued for the PCP change and sent by mail.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical members)**

- A member assigned to a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice has care-team contacts every 90 days and access to 8 clinic hours a week outside 8am to 5pm weekdays.
- A member assigned to a Standard Primary Care Provider has no care-team contact cadence and no extended-hours requirement.
- A member's change to a new PCP selected by the member takes effect on 1 May; a replacement ID card for the PCP change is mailed.
